title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover free social spaces and activities at Baylor University, from visiting the live bear mascots to exploring world-class libraries and museums without spending a dime.

cards.entity_name: Bill and Eva Williams Bear Habitat
cards.title: Visit the Live Bear Mascots
cards.subtitle: Home of Judge Indy and Judge Belle
cards.notes: Visit the AZA-accredited habitat to see Baylor's live American black bears. It is free and open to the public daily for wildlife viewing and education.
cards.short_summary: A free, public-access habitat for Baylor's live bear mascots located in the heart of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baylor Bear Habitat is open to the public daily from 9:30 a.m. until 6 p.m. - free of charge.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Baylor Bear Habitat
cards.access_notes: Open daily 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM. Bears may be inside during inclement weather or maintenance.

cards.title: Sip a Free Dr Pepper Float
cards.subtitle: A 70-Year Campus Tradition
cards.notes: Join the Baylor family for free Dr Pepper floats every Tuesday. This long-standing tradition offers a weekly social break in the Barfield Drawing Room.
cards.short_summary: A weekly social event where students and staff enjoy free Dr Pepper floats.
cards.evidence_claim: Dr Pepper Hour is a tradition... every Tuesday from 3:00 - 4:00 pm... offers students the weekly chance at a sweet treat.
cards.access_notes: Tuesdays from 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM in the Bill Daniel Student Center (SUB).

cards.title: Explore the Foyer of Meditation
cards.subtitle: World's Largest Browning Collection
cards.notes: Step into this Victorian-style library to see 62 stained-glass windows and rare manuscripts. The McLean Foyer of Meditation is a quiet spot for inspiration.
cards.short_summary: A stunning research library and museum with free public admission and historic architecture.
cards.evidence_claim: The Armstrong Browning Library & Museum is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

cards.title: Tour the Natural History Exhibits
cards.subtitle: Free Daily Entry for Students
cards.notes: Explore discovery rooms and a historic village. Baylor students get free daily admission with their ID to see the mammoth exhibits and regional history.
cards.short_summary: A natural history museum and discovery center offering free admission to Baylor students.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the Mayborn Museum is free for Baylor students every day of the week with a student ID.
cards.access_notes: Free for Baylor students with ID. Open Monday-Saturday 10 AM-5 PM, Sunday 1 PM-5 PM.

cards.title: View Rotating Art Exhibitions
cards.subtitle: Free Fine Arts Gallery
cards.notes: Visit the Hooper-Schaefer Fine Arts Center to see permanent collections and traveling exhibitions. Admission is always free for students and the public.
cards.short_summary: A campus art museum featuring diverse exhibitions with no admission fee.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the Museum is FREE to everyone.
cards.source_title: Visit Us - Martin Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday-Saturday 10 AM-5 PM, Sunday 1 PM-5 PM. Closed Mondays.

cards.title: Relax at Fountain Mall
cards.subtitle: The Heart of Campus Social Life
cards.notes: Gather at this central landmark for outdoor studying or meeting friends. The interactive water features and surrounding green space are open 24/7.
cards.short_summary: A central campus fountain and plaza used for student gatherings and relaxation.
cards.evidence_claim: Students gather on Fountain Mall around the Rosenbalm Fountain at all hours to catch up with friends or take a break.
cards.source_title: A field guide to Baylor fountains
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor space accessible 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Play Free Blacklight Bowling
cards.subtitle: Weekend Late Night Fun
cards.notes: Head to the SUB basement on Friday and Saturday nights for free blacklight bowling. It's a popular no-cost activity for students during Unight events.
cards.short_summary: Free bowling sessions for students during designated weekend late-night hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baylor Game Room... offer free blacklight bowling for students during Unight on Fridays and Saturdays from 8 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Free bowling typically available Fridays and Saturdays starting at 8:00 PM.

cards.title: Listen to the McLane Carillon
cards.subtitle: Campus-Wide Bell Concerts
cards.notes: Find a spot on the lawn to hear the 48-bell carillon play from the tower of Pat Neff Hall. These musical performances are free for anyone on campus to enjoy.
cards.short_summary: Free public bell tower concerts performed on the historic McLane Carillon.
cards.evidence_claim: Stop and listen to an entire song playing on the McLane Carillon in Pat Neff Hall.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor listening; check university calendar for scheduled performance times.

cards.title: Paddle the Brazos River
cards.subtitle: Free Watercraft for Students
cards.notes: Check out a kayak, canoe, or paddleboard for free with your student ID. It's the perfect way to explore the Brazos River right from the edge of campus.
cards.short_summary: Free rental of watercraft for Baylor students to use on the Brazos River.
cards.evidence_claim: Kayak, canoe or sail at the Baylor Marina... free for students with a valid Baylor ID.
cards.access_notes: Free for students with ID. Seasonal hours apply; typically open afternoons in spring/fall.

cards.title: Stroll the Fellowship Garden
cards.subtitle: 9th & James Edible Landscape
cards.notes: Visit this sustainable campus space to see where students grow fresh produce. It's a peaceful spot for a walk and to learn about local food security efforts.
cards.short_summary: A student-led community garden focused on sustainability and education.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baylor Community Gardens are transforming our campus into an edible learning landscape... the 'Fellowship Garden' is the founding garden.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public for walking and viewing during daylight hours.
